xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesToBalanceShee:
Notes to Cashflow:



1. Payments to reinsurer, net of commissions and claims/ benefits and Payments of claims/benefits clubbed together in the line item receipts for premium and claims, annuities and other policy benefits

2. Payments of commission, brokerage and payments of other operating expenses has been clubbed under other cash payments from operating activities

4. GST paid is clubbed under other outflows of cash under operating activities.

5. Purchase of Investment and Investment in money market instruments and liquid mutual fund is clubbed under head other cash payments to acquire equity or debt instruments under Investing actvities.

6. Proceeds from issuance of share capital and share application money is clubbed in line item proceeds from issuance of shares.

7. Breakup of cash and cash equivalents and reconciliation with cash and bank balance as per LODR not shown as the same is not part of format in the current utility
